_about: Mars Notebook fact cards. Every card needs source_url, source_date (when the source was published) and checked. checked=false means nobody has opened the source yet: the game marks it UNCHECKED in dev, and it is listed in TODO.md. Step 5 opens each source and sets checked=true or fixes the card.

facts.title: A sol is a Mars day
facts.text: One Mars day is 24 hours and 39 minutes long. Scientists call it a sol.
facts.label: REAL NASA VALUE

facts.title: The long trip
facts.text: A trip to Mars takes about 6 to 9 months. In space, no thick air blocks radiation.
facts.label: REAL NASA VALUE

facts.title: Dust stopped a lander
facts.text: NASA's InSight lander ran on solar power. Dust slowly covered its panels until it stopped.
facts.label: REAL NASA VALUE
facts.source_name: NASA JPL news (page to be confirmed)

facts.title: Flare sizes
facts.text: Flares have letter sizes: C, M and X. Each letter is 10 times stronger.
facts.label: REAL NASA VALUE

facts.title: Space salad
facts.text: Astronauts grew lettuce on the space station. In 2015 they ate some!
facts.label: REAL NASA VALUE

facts.title: Oxygen from Mars air
facts.text: The MOXIE machine on the Perseverance rover made oxygen from Mars air.
facts.label: REAL NASA VALUE

facts.title: Slow messages
facts.text: A radio message takes about 3 to 22 minutes between Earth and Mars.
facts.label: REAL NASA VALUE

facts.title: The rover and the storm
facts.text: In 2018, a giant dust storm covered Mars. The Opportunity rover lost power and went silent.
facts.label: REAL NASA VALUE
